explanation: Average Q2 margin per unit = (60 × 10 + 40 × 5) / 100 = 8 euros. Volume effect = (130 - 100) × 8 = 240 euros. Multiplying each product's own change in units by its own margin, 10 × 10 + 20 × 5 = 200, mixes the volume and mix effects: the other -40 euros is mix, because the extra units leaned towards the lower-margin chargers.
